title: Bien or bueno
rule: bueno/buena/buenos/buenas is an adjective: it describes a noun (un buen libro, una comida buena).
bien is an adverb: it describes how something is done (cantas bien) and goes with estar for feeling fine (estoy bien).
bueno becomes buen before a masculine singular noun: un buen día.

questions: Describing a noun with ser: bueno.
How he sings is an adverb: bien.
Before a masculine singular noun, bueno becomes buen.
How you speak is an adverb: bien.
How she cooks is an adverb: bien.
Before a masculine singular noun: buen amigo.
How it went is an adverb: salir bien.
How it smells is an adverb: huele bien.
